audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagree: full says Skill 7/7, content says Akshan 7/7.
audit.why: 53.49% over 989 games, and the lane's shape is one 18-second skillshot: if it misses, Zoe has no follow-up that kills Akshan. Akshan-favoured on every row is the honest read; the full layer was left on the default.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side all set to Akshan to match win[0..6], with rows 0-3 raised from 5/10 to 6/10. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 and late spikes were built on holding W camouflage to 'break her missile lock' / 'break her target lock mid-combo', and on catching her 'without portal up'.
audit.why: Zoe has no targeted lock. Paddle Star is a redirectable skillshot; Sleepy Trouble Bubble is a skillshot. Camouflage does not break anything about them. Portal Jump is 11/8/5 seconds — late it is almost always available, so 'caught without portal' is not a plan.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is about the sleep, not the ult; late, the plan is to release Comeuppance after Portal Jump has returned her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sleep's actual mechanics were never stated anywhere on the page, and one instruction was unplayable: 'Save W to negate a landed sleep into all-in' — you cannot cast while asleep.
audit.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble makes the target drowsy then asleep, reduces their Magic Resist while asleep, and the first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled up to a cap. That is the entire kill pattern and the reason body-blocking matters. Portal Jump is a 575-range blink that returns her after 1 second — a dodge, not an escape, and it dodges a Comeuppance release.
audit.corrected: Body-block or sidestep the bubble; hold the ultimate release until after the blink returns her.

audit.why: Nothing in the brief indicates a recent change to either kit; live patch is 26.15 and no patch-sensitivity claim appears on the page to verify or remove.

edits.before: Zoe's entire lane plan hinges on landing bubble, and if she misses it she has almost no follow-up damage to punish you with in a straight trade. Bait the skillshot with sidestep movement or minion blocking, then punish the cooldown with E-in aggression and empowered autos. As long as you respect her landed bubble threat and don't facecheck bushes blind, you win the lane comfortably.
edits.after: Zoe's lane plan hinges on landing Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and it is 18 seconds at rank 1 — miss it and she has only Paddle Star, which needs a long straight flight to hurt. Sidestep or body-block the bubble with minions, then take the 18 seconds: swing in and run the three-hit string. Respect the landed bubble, never facecheck a bush, and the lane is comfortable.

edits.before: Her Lvl 6 combo of bubble into ultimate burst is a real kill threat if she catches you out of position, so play a touch safer around unwarded bushes near her ult range. W's camouflage can break her target lock mid-combo if you're paying attention to her cooldowns. Outside of that specific combo window, you keep winning trades on bubble misses and cooldown punishes just like before six.
edits.after: Portal Jump is a 575-range blink that returns her after one second, on 11 seconds at rank 1 — it is not an escape from lane, it is a dodge, and it dodges the Comeuppance release. Her kill is bubble first: asleep, your MR drops and the first hit that wakes you is doubled, so the danger is the sleep, not the ult. Outside that, keep punishing every bubble miss exactly as before six.

notes: The packet's two suspectNames here are FALSE POSITIVES — 'Sleepy Trouble Bubble' and 'Spell Thief' are both correct Riot names. The real defects were mechanical: the page twice told the player to use W camouflage to 'break her target/missile lock' (Zoe has no targeted spell — Paddle Star and the bubble are both skillshots), and told them to 'save W to negate a landed sleep', which is impossible since you cannot cast while asleep. Sleep's actual behaviour — MR reduced, first damage doubled — appeared nowhere and is now stated. Full layer also referred to Zoe as 'his/he' in tldr; fixed there, but breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and report[3] still carry no gendered text so no further edit was needed. DATA NOTE: the derived flags on Zoe's E include trueDamage and terrain; Riot's description supports neither (it reduces MR and doubles the waking hit, and creates no terrain), so I wrote nothing on either and treated the _missing 'resistances-invalidated' and 'terrain-cuts-retreat' headlines as flag misfires.
